title: Fit a sine curve with a tanh network
summary: Train a 1-16-1 tanh network on noisy samples of sin(x) until its held-out mean squared error against the true curve is below 0.01.

mutants.missing_tanh_derivative: Forgets the factor 1 - h ** 2 when it sends the gradient back through the tanh layer.
mutants.gradient_sign: Uses t - out as the output gradient, so Adam climbs the loss instead of descending it.
mutants.zero_init: Starts both weight matrices at zero, so no gradient reaches the first layer and the output stays flat.
mutants.global_rng: Draws the first-layer weights from np.random and not from the rng argument, so two runs with one seed differ.
mutants.reshapes_caller_x: Sets x.shape = (-1, 1) on the caller's array, so the input changes shape.
mutants.over_budget: Trains for 2500 steps, more than the budget of 1500.
